description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) for three different model configurations across five categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as a redacted label (obscured by a solid grey rectangle), PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL, with no specific sorting applied. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "F1 Score (%)", featuring a linear scale that ranges from 80 to 100 with numeric tick labels at intervals of 10. Within each category on the horizontal axis, three bars are grouped side-by-side. As indicated by the legend at the top, the light green bars represent "MADLLM", the light purple bars represent "MADLLM w/o feature embedding", and the light orange bars represent "MADLLM w/o skip embedding". All bars feature a thin black outline. Visually, the light green "MADLLM" bar is consistently the tallest in every group. The tallest bar overall is the light green MADLLM bar in the PSM category, reaching an approximate value of 97.5%. The shortest bar overall is the light purple "MADLLM w/o feature embedding" bar in the SWaT category, at approximately 85.8%. In the remaining categories, the light green bars range from approximately 92.5% to 93.5%, while the light purple and light orange bars generally range between 89% and 90.2%, except in the PSM category where they reach approximately 93.8% and 92.8%, respectively.
